description.narrative:
Project Outcome: Stakeholder Effects Increased access to finance for social projects including MSMEs and WMSMEs: IFC anticipates that, through Khan Bank, the Project will increase access to finance of MSMEs, WMSMEs, and further grow eligible social financing portfolio of Khan Bank, especially in the rural areas, healthcare, and education.
Market Creation: Sustainability: IFC anticipates that this Project will contribute to enhancing sustainability of financial market in Mongolia, as IFC will support a systemically important bank to issue the countrys first social bond. The social bond will follow Social Bond Principles, in line with international standards, thus setting the standard in the market through demonstration and replication to lead to future social bond issuances, and contributing to the development of this new asset class in the capital market.

The proposed investment entails IFCs investment in a 3-year Social Bond to be privately issued by Khan Bank JSC (Khan Bank or the Bank) of up to US$100 million (the Bond). The proceeds of the Bond will be used to expand Khan Banks social financing portfolio by financing eligible social projects as defined by the Social Bond Framework (SBF), which will adhere to the International Capital Market Associations (ICMA) Social Bond Principles and verified by Second Party Opinion (the Project). The Bond will be the first social bond in Mongolia. The Project is the continuation of IFCs efforts to promote financial inclusion and thematic financing in Mongolia.
